samples.question: One single turn about a grid corner carries the green tile exactly onto the orange tile; call it turn A. One single turn about a grid corner carries the blue tile exactly onto the cyan tile; call it turn B. Doing turn A and then turn B has the same overall effect as one single turn about one point. Which black square holds the centre of that single turn? The four black squares are numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. Answer with exactly one of: square-1, square-2, square-3, square-4.
